subject: Day0 Activation: VPC stitch validation, traffic-sample smoke & runbook playback
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Day0 Activation: VPC stitch validation, traffic-sample smoke & runbook playback

Morning team —

Attached is the Day0 smoke checklist and a short KV-primer manifest I want to run through during T-0 to T+60. High level asks:

- Can Acme confirm the transit ACLs will permit egress to the Redwood ingress IPs and that BFD timers are at the agreed values?
- Network team: confirm firewall NAT mappings for the egress pool are in place and that the maintenance window for the NETFW rule change is scheduled at 09:30 PT.
- Ops: be ready for a runbook playback at T-30 (09:00 PT). See the drive link in the footer.

Attachments (stubs): day0-smoke-checklist.pdf, kv-primer-manifest.txt

If you see anything missing from the checklist, call it out now — we need signoff by 12:00 PT to proceed with the scheduled activation at 13:00 PT.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Network Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Acme Payments - Ops <acme-ops@acme-payments.com>

Subject: Re: Day0 Activation: VPC stitch validation, traffic-sample smoke & runbook playback

Olga —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick confirmation from our side:

- Transit ACLs updated; BFD hold timers set to 250ms as discussed.
- NAT mapping for the egress pool 34.201.12.0/28 is applied to the NGFW by 09:00 PT.
- We'll mirror the control-plane telemetry to your observability endpoint for the first 60 minutes.

Two asks from us:
1) Please include the exact iperf3 target and port for the traffic-sample (we have a restricted egress set).
2) Provide a rollback cue: if KV priming falls below 90% external hit-rate in the first 20 minutes, we will shift traffic back to the staging fabric.

Nick (cc'd) from Nimbus will assist on the NAT rules if anything chokes.

— Javier Martinez
Acme Payments, Site Reliability
acme-ops@acme-payments.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, acme-ops@acme-payments.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 12:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Day0 Activation: instrumentation & canary traffic plan

Adding instrumentation notes and the quick observability sanity file. Please make sure the following are captured in the first-hour traces:

- Per-route p50/p95 latency and token-throughput for the control-plane RPCs
- KV cache hit ratio (prefix-key level) and cold-path fallbacks
- Ingress TLS handshake error counts and mutual-TLS validation logs

Attached: observability-sanity.yaml (stub).

Canary plan (short): ramp 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 15m increments with a 5m hold for metric verification. If we see sustained p95 > 450ms or error-rate > 1.5% hold, escalate and pause.

I'll provide the iperf3 endpoint in a follow-up but plan to use port 5201 (TCP mode) and a 30s aggregate sample per test.

-Rafael
Director, Deployment Engineering
redwood.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, acme-ops@acme-payments.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700

Thanks Rafael — pinned the observability checks into the runbook and updated the traffic ramp. Runbook playback schedule:

- 09:00 PT: T-30 playback (all participants on the bridge)
- 09:30 PT: Firewall NAT rule flip and transit ACL commit
- 12:55 PT: Final readiness check (KV prime target 95% external hit)
- 13:00 PT: Live activation, start 1% canary

Attached: runbook-playback.log (placeholder), post-smoke-tasks.csv (placeholder).

Please be on the bridge at T-30. If anyone cannot make the 09:00 slot, reply now with an alternate contact.

Olga

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com, acme-ops@acme-payments.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Day0 Activation: Live summary and short post-activation notes

On Mon, Mar 2, 2026 at 08:12 AM Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com> wrote:
> Morning team —
> 
> Attached is the Day0 smoke checklist and a short KV-primer manifest I want to run through during T-0 to T+60.

Quick post-activation readout:

- Activation completed at 13:00 PT; canary ramp followed the 1%->10%->50% plan.
- Observability: initial KV hit-rate reached 94% at T+12m, stabilized to 96% by T+22m after a rapid prefix warm.
- Anomaly: at T+30m we saw spike in TLS handshake errors (~0.6% of connections) tied to a mismatched client cipher from a third-party monitoring probe; Nexus probe was blocked by updated NGFW cipher policy. We rolled a short ACL bypass for probe subnet and TLS errors returned to baseline within 7 minutes. Logged in post-smoke-tasks.csv.

Next steps:
1) Formalize the probe bypass exception with Acme network team (tracking: HUBSPOT:contact_3245).
2) Rafael to run a 24h telemetry sweep and flag regressions.
3) Ops to close the Day0 checklist in Drive and attach the signed acceptance.

Thanks everyone for a clean execution — no rollback required.

—Marissa Cole
Sr. Engineering Manager, Customer Activation
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
